Class Meteor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.projectile.Projectile
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.projectile.Meteor
public class Meteor extends Projectile
Represents a meteor projectile that targets a player's ship. Meteors can be either SMALL or LARGE and originate from a specific direction (source). Players must defend against them using shields or cannons depending on the meteor's size.

      public Meteor(Projectile.Size size, Projectile.Source source)
      Constructs a new Meteor with the specified size and source direction. Used in typical gameplay where the path index is determined by dice.

      source - the direction from which the meteor is fired

  • Method Details

    • evaluateDefense

      public boolean evaluateDefense(Player player)
      Evaluates whether the player successfully defends against this meteor.
      • If the path is empty, no defense is needed and no damage is taken.
      • If the meteor is SMALL:
        • If no exposed connector is hit, no effect.
        • If the side is shielded, it's successfully blocked.
      • If the meteor is LARGE:
        • If only a single cannon defends, it fails to block.
        • If a double cannon defends, it's successfully blocked.
      • If not blocked, the meteor damages the ship via player.applyProjectile().
      Specified by:
      evaluateDefense in class Projectile
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose ship is being targeted
      Returns:
      true if the meteor can be blocked; false if it hits or miss completely the ship
